queries.sql: create table if not exists projects(id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,repo_name varchar(255) not null unique,current_stars integer,current_forks integer,current_watchers integer,last_pushed_at timestamp(6) with time zone,last_polled_at timestamp(6) with time zone)

create table if not exists star_history(id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,project_id bigint not null references projects(id),star_count integer not null,recorded_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null)
select star_count from star_history where project_id=? order by recorded_at desc,id desc limit 1
select h.*,p.repo_name from star_history h join projects p on p.id=h.project_id where project_id in (?,?,?) order by recorded_at,h.id
select * from projects where repo_name in (?,?,?) order by repo_name
